name: Thunder-Fang Chimera Will

acquire.equipPiece: A single ram-horn bracer on the left forearm, sparking at the tip (the only equipped piece).

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form: the whole body becomes a three-natured chimera-humanoid in storm-iron armor: lion head with fangs and a static mane, a ram head with curled horns on the left shoulder guard, a serpent-headed tail in a scale sheath, clawed forelimbs and digitigrade legs with greaves; a ram-horn thunder lance forms in the hand.

equip.weapon: A ram-horn thunder lance with a lion-fang head, crackling with arcs.
equip.armor: Lion-mane pauldron plates, a curled ram-horn shoulder guard (the second head), serpent-scale tail sheath and storm-iron greaves.
equip.hair_eyes: A mane of crackling static for hair, blue-white glowing eyes.
equip.aura: Yellow-blue storm aura with arcing bolts.

beastNote: Thunder-Fang Chimera (lion head, ram head, serpent tail)
lore: The will of a three-bodied storm beast: a lion's fangs, a ram's charge and a venomous serpent tail, all crackling with thunder.
pitch: The Thunder-Fang Chimera is a lion, ram and serpent in one storm-wrapped beast. Acquire keeps you human, trailing yellow static with one sparking ram-horn bracer. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a lion-headed beastman with a ram-head shoulder guard, serpent tail and a thunder lance, at a higher drain than any A will.
untrained: An untrained holder's three instincts fight each other: static arcs over the body, limbs twitch against the holder's wishes (screen jitter) and strain jumps on every discharge. The will lay dormant until forcibly awakened; if the holder cannot balance it the clash tears at body and core and can kill, and only training the holder's own core and the beast core (best teacher: the beast itself) tames it.

spirit.echo: A lion-headed beastman in storm-iron armor with a ram's head on the left shoulder guard and a serpent-headed tail; fanged jaws, curled horns, a static mane, digitigrade legs, a thunder lance.
spirit.look: A pale-yellow orb split into three bands (mane gold, ram-horn spiral, serpent scale) with a blue-white arc crawling around it.
